visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a close-up of a young woman with long dark hair in a car's back seat, wearing a grey crop top and denim shorts. She speaks to the camera while gesturing. Text overlays appear. (2) The scene cuts to an outdoor urban setting where the woman poses next to a black BMW GT. Multiple shots show her sitting on the hood and leaning against the car while close-ups highlight the car's grille and wheels. (3) The woman is then seen in an indoor studio setting with soft lighting, looking distressed and holding her head. News clippings about illegal airport taxis are displayed on screen as overlays. (4) She transitions back to a medium shot holding a smartphone, demonstrating an app. The background is a simple interior wall. She points to features on the screen. (5) New footage shows her inside a spacious luxury Lexus LM van, demonstrating seat space and interior lighting. A male driver is visible in the front seat. (6) A sequence of app screen recordings shows the booking process and specific insurance/delay features. The woman appears in insets, winking and smiling. (7) The final phase shows her exiting the luxury van at an airport terminal, wearing the grey top again, followed by a brand logo animation.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a high-pitched, energetic female voice speaking Mandarin quickly. An upbeat electronic pop track with a steady 4/4 beat starts immediately. The vocal tone is bright and persuasive. (2) A sharp 'whoosh' sound effect triggers as the visuals transition. The speaker maintains a high arousal level. The BGM remains consistent in tempo. No ambient environmental noise is audible, suggesting a clean recording. (3) A digital 'ding' sound accompanies the appearance of text news headlines. The vocal pitch lowers slightly to convey concern, with more deliberate pauses. The percussive elements of the BGM continue underneath. (4) A series of 'pop' and digital UI 'click' sounds occur as the app features are highlighted. The vocal energy returns to a high, positive valence. The speech rate increases again. (5) As the pricing for luxury vans is mentioned, a subtle synthesizer swell occurs in the music. The voice is enthusiastic and clearly articulated. Short spectral bursts from transition SFX are frequent. (6) The walkthrough phase features multiple UI confirmation sounds. The speaker explains the 'iCare' insurance benefit with professional clarity. The BGM maintains a driving, rhythmic quality until a final brand jingle stinger at the end.
